scope: Customer refund and narrow ADMIN full reversal interface. Existing P06 multi-instance concurrency/authorization proofs remain mandatory; P08C adds browser stale/racing adjustment and independent journal oracles. Schedules, webhooks, broader administrator UI and P09-P11 remain incomplete.

requirements.statement: Recipient-owner partial/full refunds use exact currency amounts, explicit confirmation, separate immutable journals and authoritative unrefunded totals.
Only ADMIN can inspect the narrow reversal surface and submit a full otherwise-unadjusted settlement reversal with a mandatory reason.
Lost committed refund/reversal responses preserve the exact request/key across reload and reauthentication and return one adjustment effect on replay.
Owner-filtered context and nested receipts deny outsiders and ordinary payer refund authority; recipient balance/version is not disclosed to the payer.
Competing/stale refunds, reversal-after-refund, refund-after-reversal and reversal/spending limits cannot overcompensate or manufacture funds; immutable entries independently reconcile.
Receipts and paged history retain original and adjustment journals, separate base/adjustment states, and do not convert failed lookups into financial failure.
Critical customer/admin forms, dialogs, receipts, validation and denial pages execute authenticated axe and keyboard/focus checks at desktop/tablet/mobile with no functional retries.
Permanent exact-SHA P08C gate preserves P01-P08B and binds requirements to actually executed contracts, PostgreSQL/HTTP cases and real Compose browser journeys.
